# Superpowers for ME3

The `skills/` tree and MIT license come from obra/superpowers v7.0.2, commit `22f0b463e7a5e579904dd6211a520321035526f7`. Pi loads these workflows explicitly from this checkout. Its voice foreground can delegate a named workflow to an isolated ME3 subagent. The project supplies the Pi integration.

[Upstream release](https://github.com/obra/superpowers/tree/22f0b463e7a5e579904dd6211a520321035526f7)
